name: Misty Explosion
description: You release a massive explosion in a {shape}, fainting immediately before the damage is dealt. Creatures in the area must make a {save}. If your creature has at least half its hit points left or this move was used on Misty Terrain, anyone in range takes {dice} {type} damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. If your creature has less than half of its hit points left and was not on Misty Terrain, the damage is halved for a failed save, and quartered for a success.
